buildCommand: CURRENT_DIR=$(pwd); if [ -d client ]; then npm run build --workspace=client && rm -rf "$CURRENT_DIR/dist" && cp -r client/dist "$CURRENT_DIR/dist"; elif [ -f ../client/package.json ]; then cd ../client && npm install && npm run build && cd "$CURRENT_DIR" && rm -rf dist && cp -r ../client/dist dist; elif [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"client"' package.json; then npm run build; else echo "client directory not found" && exit 1; fi
